raw_text: China's most advanced surface warship, the Type 055 guided-missile destroyer Yan'an (hull 103), has entered the Indian Ocean for a task group exercise. The 13,000-tonne vessel transited the Strait of Malacca accompanied by a Type 903A replenishment ship. Indian Navy P-8I Poseidon aircraft and a warship from the Eastern Fleet have been deployed for surveillance. The deployment marks the second time a Type 055 has operated in the Indian Ocean Region this year, signalling increased PLAN blue-water capability.
clean_text: Type 055 destroyer Yan'an entered Indian Ocean for task group exercise. Indian Navy P-8I and Eastern Fleet warship deployed for surveillance. Second Type 055 IOR deployment in 2024.
